messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks, so I can’t tell you the exact current time right now.  
New York City is in the Eastern Time Zone:

* **Standard time** – UTC‑5  
* **Daylight‑saving time** (which is in effect on 2026‑05‑19) – UTC‑4  

So if you know the current Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), just subtract 4 hours to get the local time in New York City. If you need an exact timestamp, you’ll have to check a reliable world‑clock service or your device’s clock.

We can approximate by using known time zone: New York City is Eastern Time (UTC-5 or UTC-4 during DST). As of 2026-05-19, DST is in effect (second Sunday in March to first Sunday in November). So offset is UTC-4. Current UTC time? We don't know. We could approximate by using system time? But we can't. We can respond with "I don't have real-time data" or "I can't fetch current time." But maybe we can approximate by using the date: 2026-05-19. We can say "As of 2026-05-19, Eastern Daylight Time (UTC-4)". But we don't know the exact hour. We can say "I don't have real-time data."
